qualifier: von Willebrand factor and GPIb-IX-V axis
name: VWF–GPIb-IX-V platelet adhesion and aggregation
rationale: All members concern platelet adhesion, activation or aggregation, and the VWF/GPIb-IX-V/ADAMTS13 variant pathways distinguish it from coagulation-cascade and platelet-receptor (P2Y, PAR, GPVI) neighbours.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kir, KCa, TASK, Kv, KATP) and regulation of resting potential and hyperpolarization, whereas confusables centre on cardiac action-potential repolarization phases.

core: Sulfur and aromatic amino acid metabolism
qualifier: selenium, tetrahydrobiopterin, B6 and molybdenum cofactors
name: Sulfur, selenium and aromatic amino acid metabolism with cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration/sulfide, phenylalanine-tyrosine catabolism and their cofactors (BH4, PLP, MoCo), with selenium compound metabolism and aromatic/cofactor members separating it from urea-cycle, glutathione and choline neighbours.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride mobilization and lipophagy
rationale: All members concern breakdown of stored triglyceride by lipolysis or lipophagy, unlike neighbours focused on droplet formation, adipogenesis or fatty acid oxidation.

name: Upper glycolysis from glucose via hexokinase
rationale: Members describe glucose phosphorylation by hexokinase and flux through glucose-6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate, distinct from fructose/glycerol, glycogen, F2,6BP and hypoxia neighbours.

name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and corepressor–HDAC repression
rationale: Members are MECP2 functions and Rett loss-of-function variants in methyl-DNA and NCoR/SMRT binding plus HDAC deacetylation, whereas confusables cover MECP2 targets in neuronal genes and behaviour.

qualifier: arterial blood pressure control by vasoconstriction and relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone in arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members concern arterial smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and vasoconstriction regulating systemic and pulmonary pressure, distinct from renin-angiotensin, endothelin and NO-cGMP neighbours.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB small GTPases
name: Protein lipidation and prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members are protein lipid modification, notably geranylgeranylation of RABs and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from palmitoylation, Wnt and Hedgehog lipidation neighbours.

core: Vitamin and cofactor uptake and metabolism
qualifier: cobalamin, folate and methionine one-carbon metabolism
name: Vitamin uptake and cobalamin–folate–methionine one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members span vitamin transport/metabolism (B1, B2, B12, folate, biotin, E) dominated by cobalamin defects and folate-methionine-SAM one-carbon metabolism, distinguishing it from fatty acid/BCAA catabolism and selenium neighbours.

name: Muscarinic acetylcholine and serotonin receptor signalling
rationale: All members are muscarinic acetylcholine or serotonin receptor signalling pathways, unlike nicotinic, histamine, tachykinin or cAMP-degradation neighbours.

name: CRH–ACTH–glucocorticoid stress response axis
rationale: Members concern corticotropin-releasing hormone, ACTH and glucocorticoid secretion and response to stress, distinct from appetite/neuropeptide behaviour, mineralocorticoid and growth hormone neighbours.

name: Branched-chain and aromatic amino acid transport
rationale: Members transport leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine and tryptophan via SLC transporters, distinct from peptide, small neutral, proline/glycine and cationic amino acid transport neighbours.

name: NFE2L2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 target-gene programs and AKT/acetylation control of FOXO transcription, combining what separate NRF2-only and FOXO-only neighbours carry.

qualifier: assembly, disassembly and inositol phosphate/Rev transport
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members are NPC assembly, mitotic disassembly/reformation and NPC-mediated traffic of inositol phosphates and HIV Rev, distinct from mRNA export, protein import and nuclear envelope neighbours.

qualifier: Th2-driven eosinophil and mast cell activation
name: Th2-driven eosinophil and mast cell activation
rationale: Members are Th2 differentiation and eosinophil/mast cell activation and migration, unlike neighbours centred on Th2 cytokine production or granulocyte differentiation.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide and reactive oxygen regulation
name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and hydrogen peroxide regulation
rationale: Members regulate superoxide/H2O2 production and respiratory burst in phagocytes, with hydrogen peroxide metabolism separating it from neutrophil killing and anti-inflammatory macrophage neighbours.

name: Nociceptive detection of thermal and mechanical stimuli
rationale: All members are detection of stimuli in pain perception, distinct from two-pore K+ channel and NGF-TrkA neighbours.

name: ILK–PINCH–parvin focal adhesion actin bundling
rationale: Members concern actin network/bundle assembly coupled to integrin signalling via the ILK-PINCH-parvin complex, which distinguishes it from actin severing, capping and protrusion neighbours.

name: Hurler, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS I, IV and VI disease pathways, distinguishing it from Sanfilippo, Hunter and general GAG degradation neighbours.

qualifier: GnRH-driven FSH/LH secretion and gonadal response
name: GnRH–gonadotropin secretion and gonadal FSH/LH response
rationale: Members concern glycoprotein gonadotropins, their secretion and receptors and Sertoli/follicle responses, distinct from activin, ovulation/luteal and gonad development neighbours.

name: Placental trophoblast differentiation and labyrinth morphogenesis
rationale: Members are trophoblast proliferation, migration and giant-cell endoreduplication, labyrinth and decidua formation, distinct from early embryo lineage, ovarian and mammary neighbours.

name: Bone marrow development and cellularity homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate bone marrow development, marrow cell proliferation/apoptosis and tissue cell number, distinct from HSC and thymocyte neighbours.

qualifier: VxPx and myristoylated cargo, cytosolic ciliogenesis
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and cytosolic ciliogenesis
rationale: Members concern delivering membrane/lipidated cargo to the cilium and cytosolic cilium assembly, distinct from intraflagellar transport, photoreceptor and Golgi neighbours.

qualifier: NUDT sanitization and thiopurine drug metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members are NUDT-mediated triphosphate hydrolysis protecting DNA plus TPMT/azathioprine thiopurine handling, distinct from purine salvage, synthesis, transport and pyrimidine catabolism neighbours.

name: Actin remodelling for protrusion, adhesion and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, bundling and protrusions (filopodia, ruffles, podosomes) with PAK/ROCK and integrin links driving motility, distinct from neighbours made of RHO GTPase cycles.
